info.name: FolderBell
info.summary: Notify me when this folder changes
info.description: M0 development slice: no UI, no email, no aggregation yet. This build exists to observe how filesystem events actually fire in practice — desktop client uploads, WebDAV, mobile app, changes inside a shared folder and, as priority, changes inside a Team Folder with Advanced Permissions (ACLs) active — before any user-facing behavior is built on top of it.
info.author: Ricardo Ferreira
